title: Maybe
summary: Errors and absence become explicit states, adopted gradually at the edges of PHP 7.4 systems.
context: Legacy systems mix null, false, exceptions, and validation. Maybe explores an incremental transition without requiring a rewrite.
constraints: Process concurrency with clear security boundaries.

decisions.title: Explicit errors
decisions.body: Result and Option make failure and absence part of the contract.

decisions.title: Adopt at the edges
decisions.body: Schema and DTO enter first where external data crosses the system.

decisions.title: Async as a process boundary
decisions.body: The core stays synchronous; concurrency, timeout, and serialization belong to their own boundary.

evidence.label: Public API
evidence.detail: Versioned types and examples in the repository.

evidence.label: Async boundary
evidence.detail: Serialization, timeout, and isolation are observable responsibilities.

limits: Async does not replace durable queues or operational supervision.
The application remains responsible for idempotency, resources, and recovery.
License and source commit await pinning after audit.
